raw.mhra_alert_body: DMRC reference number DMRC - 39754868 Marketing Authorisation Holder Example Pharma UK Ltd Medicine Details Cutaneous solution 1mL applicator PL: 17780/0858 Active Ingredient: Chlorhexidine Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. 4L01372H Expiry Date 11/2027 Pack Size 28 Background The company is recalling one batch as a precautionary measure due to a potential breach of sterility in the packaging process. Advice for healthcare professionals: stop supplying the affected batch immediately and quarantine remaining stock.
raw.summary: A manufacturer is recalling batches of a 2% w/v / 70% v/v cutaneous solution 1mL applicator due to a potential breach of sterility in the packaging process.
raw.title: Class 2 Medicines Recall: Example Pharma UK Ltd, Cutaneous solution 1mL applicator, EL(26)A/34
